about_the_game:
Grid Raid Heroes is an offline cyberpunk turn-based strategy game where you recruit powerful heroes, join factions, and battle massive raid bosses in a city ruled by corporations and underground syndicates.

Key Features:

  • 🚀 Automated Combat – Deploy your heroes into strategic battles. AI-powered combat lets you focus on tactics, gear, and upgrades.

  • 👾 Raid Boss Challenges – Time-limited boss events that test your team’s power and preparation.

  • 💎 Resource Acquisition – Earn rare tokens, currency, and upgrade items from missions and victories.

  • ⬆️ Hero Advancement – Upgrade stats, feed heroes power-up items, and ascend them to legendary greatness.

  • 🛡️ Gear Optimization – Farm weapons and armor with unique stat spreads for the ultimate loadout.

  • 🤝 Faction Reputation – Ally with factions, unlock exclusive shops, and challenge rival groups for dominance.

Innovative Phantom Service Live Ops (PSLO)
Enjoy evolving live events and new content without heavy server dependence. Events are triggered dynamically on your device for a seamless and resilient play experience.

Are you ready to conquer the grid? Join the revolution today.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound
